# CANDIDATE: TP1_PREMIUM_SWEEP_FOR_BEARISH_SETUP

**Filed:** 2026-08-18
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** exit_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adjusting the TP1 premium percentage for the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup can improve OOS edge_capture by optimizing profit-taking across market regimes. A lower TP1 may capture profits faster in volatile or reversing markets, reducing loser-day losses, while a higher TP1 may allow more runner extension on strong trend days like 5/04, increasing winner-day profits. We seek a TP1 value that increases edge_capture above 771 without degrading IS performance.

## Mechanism

Test TP1 premium percentages from 10% to 100% in 10% increments for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON, holding all other parameters (strike, stop, trailing, etc.) fixed. For each TP1 value, run Stage-1 backtest on OOS period (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) and compute edge_capture on the 6 J anchor days. Select the TP1 yielding highest edge_capture >771, then validate with walk-forward (OOS/IS Sharpe ≥0.70, per-month return consistency) and real-fills checks on top-3 J days. Use IS period (2024-07-01 to 2024-12-31) to ensure no significant IS degradation.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on risk-rules.md position sizing)
2. **Sample bias:** OOS sample = ~400 trading days (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), time-based selection. Overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward validation and regime stability checks; parameter sweep increases overfit risk, necessitating strict OOS gates.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will conduct walk-forward held-out window as part of Stage-1 backtest)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will use real OPRA simulator for validation)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Strong trend day (e.g., 5/04) where low TP1 caps profits, reducing winner-day capture.
   - Max drawdown: Could increase if TP1 too low and losses run deeper before止损.
   - Blow-up scenario: TP1 too high in choppy market → profits given back, increasing loser-day losses or reducing winner-day gains.
6. **Concentration:** Will monitor top-5 day P&L concentration; if >50% of OOS P&L, flag as overfit risk and require further regime stratification.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: All gym tests must pass for modified TP1 parameter.
- Walk-forward: OOS/IS Sharpe ratio ≥0.70 and per-month OOS return within ±20% of IS.
- Real-fills: Top-3 J days must show <20% difference between BS-sim and real OPRA fills in P&L.
- No J anchor regression: Edge_capture must not decrease below current level; target >771.
- IS performance: No significant degradation in IS edge_capture or Sharpe vs baseline.
